sources.observed_relation: ## Parent and role Parent programme spine: #165 Integrated prototype / strong-LLM comparison: #73 This issue is the **first external capability bridge** between the current OCM research programme and serious software-engineering agents. It does **not** replace #165, create a new cognitive core, or claim standalone OCM parity with frontier coding models. It exists to answer a narrower causal question first: > **Under the same foundation model, tools, benchmark tasks, memory permissions and resource budget, does adding OCM state/control improve a software-engineering agent? If yes, which OCM mechanisms cause the improvement; if not, which mechanisms are unnecessary, harmful, or blocked by a deeper representation/control gap?** The issue should feed evidence back into #165's ordered programme rather than open a parallel architecture lane. --- # 1. Why this issue is first The current OCM programme already has bounded evidence for persistent state, method learning/reuse, composition, failure memory, revision and governed control, but it does not yet have a serious external software-engineering comparison at frontier-agent scale. sources.observed_relation: The math supplement needs to measure whether changing independent capability changes delegation needs. The previous runner could revise a candidate while appearing to COMMIT, and forced search and deployed policy did not share the same revision semantics. That makes the key same-state attribution unreliable. This change introduces protocol v2 for the math supplement: - Routing emits exactly COMMIT or one unused subagent call. COMMIT submits the stored candidate unchanged. Forced branches and deployed policy use the same revision function, prompts and sequence seeds; the environment supplies the verifier's actual candidate. - Train call decisions, successful terminal revisions, literal COMMIT and complete independent solutions. Preserve inference prompt tokens when Qwen3.5 BPE merges whitespace at the response boundary. - Use two-round `dynamic_sft` versus refreshed random-success `success_sft`, with optional initial-data `static_sft`. Match optimizer steps and accumulation; report actual tokens without claiming equal FLOPs. Disable the incompatible legacy GRPO entry point. - Add fixed-initial-cohort internalization, aligned before/after calls on learned questions, remaining-rescue
sources.title: Audit and correct math self-training protocol, controls and RunPod workflow
